snippet.description:
Most UPSC aspirants analyse topper copies by counting the number of points, thinkers, keywords, or scholars used in the answer. But that is not the right way to evaluate a UPSC Mains answer.

In this video, understand how to actually analyse a UPSC topper copy—by reading the answer from start to finish and checking whether the candidate has understood and addressed the demand of the question.

Learn the difference between quantitative and qualitative analysis and avoid getting influenced by impressive thinkers, keywords, or presentation alone.
